VERDICT: REPAIR
Pass 1 independently reviewed candidate 2af1b3404df59a89190e47cf33d352e5e7adc58d after confirming HEAD and reading the full base-to-candidate diff, source and tests; per-criterion verdicts: AC-3 satisfied in implementation (src/math.mjs:69-78, test/math.test.mjs:85-90), R-1 satisfied (src/math.mjs:69-71), R-2 satisfied (src/math.mjs:72-78), R-3 satisfied (diff only appends range and its tests and edits the permitted import at test/math.test.mjs:3), R-4 satisfied (diff touches only src/math.mjs and test/math.test.mjs, no dependencies or generated changes), R-5 satisfied (test/math.test.mjs:85,88).
Finding: MEDIUM, test/math.test.mjs:85-90 — both added tests cover only valid outputs, leaving the required empty-array RangeError, invalid-shape/element TypeError and input preservation without regression coverage; removing the validation guards would still pass every shipped range test, so the smallest verification of repair is to add range-prefixed assertions for empty input, non-array input, nonnumeric/nonfinite elements and unchanged input, then rerun the isolated range suite.
Checks run: node --test --test-name-pattern="^range" test/ exited 0 with "tests 2", "pass 2", "fail 0"; npm test exited 1 with "tests 17", "pass 16", "fail 1" and only "clamp respects upper bound" failing (expected unchanged baseline, not a finding); independent node -e assertions exited 0 with "PASS: empty-array, 5 invalid-shape, 9 invalid-element, frozen-input/nonmutation, singleton, negative and fractional assertions" after the initial heredoc invocation was blocked before execution by sandbox temporary-file restrictions; git diff --check exited 0 with no output and git status --short was empty; no files changed, no required checks unavailable, remaining work is durable regression coverage and coordinator acceptance, with no observed range implementation defect.
